title: pm sidecar daily notes
content:
Morning capture - quick brain dump
Date: 2026-03-13
Owner: Sofia

---
AM standup notes (8:30)
- Eng: kernel tweak landed for prefix-cache; needs perf run (Chris).
- Infra: staging capacity increased 2x for smoke (Nadia).
- SRE: alerting updated to include token-level latency heatmap (Marco).
- UX: small copy tweak to error modal (Priya) - shipping later today.

PRD edits to finish (section refs inline)
- Section: "Canary rollout policy" - clarify metrics and thresholds (latency p95, error-rate). TODO: add explicit numbers and fallback model mapping. (Action: Sofia by 2026-03-14)
- Section: "Billing / Quota implications" - remove ambiguous wording re reserve ticks; add example table. (Action: Liam to draft sample table)
- Add note about private-deployments limitations for on-prem firewall rules (Action: Marco to confirm with infra)
- Inline comment: change phrase "seamless failover" -> "automated fallback with degraded throughput" (resolve: done)

Stakeholder follow-ups (prioritized)
1) Legal - data residency clause for EU customers using private plane. Need confirmation on KMS options. (Ping: legal@redwood) -- Due EOD 3/15.
2) Sales AE brief - launch messaging deck + FAQ for beta customers. (Action: Sofia to send draft)
3) Solutions eng - runbook for migrations from hosted -> dedicated. Ask: expected downtime windows? (Marco owning)
4) Observability team - expose token-level cost metric to console; essential for rollouts. (Nadia/Observability)

Launch checklist (quick preflight) - status: in progress
- [x] PRD final draft (core) - most sections updated
- [ ] Canary config YAML - needs review (open PR)
- [x] Staging smoke tests - baseline passed 3/12
- [ ] Rollout runbook doc + on-call list - draft exists, needs contact verification
- [ ] Customer comms + support playbook - outline ready, need FAQ
- [ ] Billing integration test across quotas - pending test account sign-up

Rollback criteria (short)
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for > 5 minutes AND error-rate spike > 0.5% => pause canary and route to fallback model.
- Significant model output regressions on eval prompts (see eval-run id: eval-2026-03-12-17).

Quick metrics to watch during initial canary (dash IDs)
- token-throughput-per-gpu (dash: infra/throughput-03)
- per-route-latency-p95 (dash: product/latency-11)
- cost-per-token-by-model (dash: finance/cost-07)
- prompt-eval-pass-rate (dash: quality/eval-03)

Open questions / blockers
- Can we increase max prefix cache size without bumping memory across dedicated nodes? (Eng: depends on kernel patch; Chris investigating)
- Do we want to allow a 1% traffic burst for beta customers as a controlled ramp? (Decision: tradeoff with SLA for beta)
- Need confirmation from partner infra on cross-region fallback latency (ask: SRE)

Notes to self (short)
- Call with Liam at 11:00 — bring sample billing table.
- Remind Priya about UI copy deadline 4pm.
- Drop quick demo link in sales channel after noon.

Fragments / scratch ideas
- Consider adding a short "cost impact" badge per model in model catalog for easy comparison.
- Mini checklist for customer on-boarding that lives in console (single-click enable telemetry).

Scratch links / refs
- Slack thread: #launch-bina (search: "canary config v2")
- PR: runtime PR #298 (perf regressions fixed)
- Eval run id: eval-2026-03-12-17 (compare against baseline-run-2026-02-26)

End of capture - will iterate after 11:00 sync
